subject: Educação Física
description_pt: Experimentar diferentes papéis (jogador, árbitro e técnico) e fruir os esportes de rede/parede, campo e taco, invasão e combate, valorizando o trabalho coletivo e o protagonismo.

components.description_pt: Identificar responsabilidades distintas dos papéis de jogador, árbitro e técnico em contextos esportivos
components.description_en: Identify the distinct responsibilities of player, referee, and coach roles in sports contexts
components.cc_component_description: Identify the components of a defined system and describe their roles

components.description_pt: Exercer papel de árbitro ou técnico em atividades esportivas, aplicando regras e orientações relevantes
components.description_en: Perform the role of referee or coach during sport activities, applying relevant rules and guidance
components.cc_component_description: Follow agreed-upon rules and norms during collaborative discussions

components.description_pt: Avaliar como trabalho em equipe e autonomia individual contribuem ao desempenho e resultados esportivos
components.description_en: Evaluate how teamwork and individual agency contribute to sport performance and outcomes
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate how the connections between components of a system affect its overall performance

cc_matches.description: Follow agreed-upon rules for discussions and carry out assigned roles.
A system can be described in terms of its components and their interactions.

Investigating or designing new systems or structures requires a detailed examination of the properties of different materials, the structures of different components, and connections of components to reveal its function and/or solve a problem.
